verso-plugin-firewall.description: Session grants for Verso's Firewall pages: the firewall config, and the network and dhcp configs its zones and rules name; this plugin's own root read of each rule's hit counters (ADR-027); the helper's listing of fw4's rule files; and staging a rule file through the helper's file journal. The shell holds the operator's session and performs these on the plugin's behalf (ADR-007), so this file is what makes the manifest's declared acl grantable at rpcd — the plugin itself holds no session and no privilege.
